summary: A clear step up from w8 (7.4). The headrest now has the right composition: the navy flap is the dominant panel with the wing pads beside it (visible flap / headrest 0.59 in b3 head-on and 0.63 in q14, against 0.60-0.70 in py_37301 / 37302). The gooseneck matches san_26 / py_37305: silver root bullet, a slim smooth arm down the flank and a near-vertical head with a forward lens. The shell top is one soft arch, and the corduroy beat is mostly gone. It is not yet 8.5, for four reasons. (1) The wing pads sink into the side bolsters, leaving a jagged saw-tooth intersection that shows even at cabin distance in q14. (2) The wing petal cloth is still about half the photo contrast. (3) From behind, the shell rim above the screen is about twice the photo height. (4) Close up, the back cloth is still a regular brick barcode, and at distance it is about 60 % as crisp as py_37301.

calibration.issue: w8a medium / w8b HIGH: wings in front of the flap, flap reads as a narrow strip (I-beam)
calibration.status: fixed. Flap / headrest-with-wings width: b3 head-on 215/365 = 0.59, q14 centre seat 0.63, against py_37301 0.60-0.65 and py_37302 0.63-0.70. Head-on flap h/w is 205/215 = 0.95, against 37301 ~0.95-1.0. In q13 the foreground flap still reads tall (h/w ~1.5), mostly because of the view pitch: the second-row flaps are 1.15 against the photo's 0.72-0.97.

calibration.issue: w8a medium: gooseneck stowed pose (35 deg head, thick arm across the wing)
calibration.status: fixed. The arm is r 6.5 mm on a smooth 10-point Bezier along the flank edge. The head hangs near-vertical, outboard of the wing, with a forward lens and a dark end ring. From behind (q13b) the horizontal silver root bullet, the round button and the hanging head all match san_26 (x150-320). Minor: the heads render nearly white rather than brushed silver.

calibration.issue: w8a medium / w8b low: back cloth reads as corduroy rows / regular barcode
calibration.status: mostly fixed at cabin distance. Vertical high-pass autocorrelation (4 px box) at lags 4/5: q14 +0.12/+0.17 (w8 +0.29/+0.28) and q13 +0.22/+0.11 (w8 +0.32), against py_37301 within +-0.14. The tile row-profile autocorrelation dropped from 0.91 to 0.52 at lag 12. Not fixed close up: b10 has ac -0.61 at lag 4 and +0.35 at lag 8, so it is still an even brick barcode against py_37305's mottled tweed. Crispness is unchanged: gx/gy is q14 13/19 against 37301 22/32.

calibration.issue: w8a low: console lid gap to the cup nose / trim shelf
calibration.status: fixed. The lid now reaches z -0.465 and overlaps the nose (-0.5425..-0.4475). The trim no longer overhangs. The nose is still a thin 22 mm slab over the body (p5), which is acceptable.

calibration.issue: w8a low / w7a low: literature pocket flat panel, mesh not at the bottom
calibration.status: partly fixed. The smile-shaped lip and the full-width bottom net are in (b7, b11, p2). The net is a straight flat band. In san_26 the net follows the bucket's curved bottom, and its top edge is the smile.

calibration.issue: w8a low / w8b low: flap hem royal, mid-height seam line
calibration.status: fixed. It is one sheet with no lit seam (b3, b4). The hem matches the flap hue.

calibration.issue: w8a low / w7b low: no hourglass lumbar seams
calibration.status: added but artefacted. They are 1.8 mm navy tubes that read as hairline cracks. In b10 and b6 they dip in and out of the cloth: the lower ends are broken off, leaving a separate stub near y 0.08.

calibration.issue: w8a low / w8b medium: wing petal cloth low contrast
calibration.status: partly fixed. Wing luminance spread (p90-p10)/p50: q14 0.40 (w8 0.23), q13 foreground 0.53 (w8 0.35-0.38), against py_37301 0.91, py_37302 foreground 1.06 and py_37305 1.01. Dark share is 0.03-0.04 against 0.15-0.31.

calibration.issue: w8a low / w8b medium: shell top faceted chamfer / crease
calibration.status: fixed. 15 sections give one continuous soft arch (q13b, b1, b13), like py_37304.

calibration.issue: w8b medium: wing domes + navy over-top show above the rim from behind at standing height
calibration.status: not fixed at standing height. In b1 (eye 1.65, 1.0 m behind) and b13, both wing domes and the navy over-top band still show over the upper corners. At seated height (q13b) only a ~3 px sliver shows at the right seat's top-left corner. Downgraded to low: san_13 shows the side fabric and a wing beside the shell from a raised viewpoint, so some of it is real.

calibration.issue: handed off: blank placards, sun diamond on the 26A back
calibration.status: still present, not scored against PY.

The pad and the bolster also read as one continuous block, with no crease under the pad. In py_37305 / 37301 each pad has a clean rounded bottom sitting on the back, with a shadow crease under it.

Move the placards on(0.60, ...) -> on(0.63, ...), and the literature bucket py0 0.38 -> 0.40, so the gaps stay as in py_37304. Keep the shell top at 0.967, because it must still hide the headrest at 0.905. The bezel top then reaches 0.917 and the rim is ~0.05 (0.19 of the bezel height). issues.issue: The wing petal cloth is still about half the photo contrast. The pads read as soft blue-grey with sparse small white ovals, not py_37302 / 37305's bright irregular petals on a dark mottled ground.
issues.evidence: Wing luminance spread (p90-p10)/p50 and dark share (<0.75x median): q14 0.40 / 0.03, q13 foreground 0.53 / 0.04, against py_37301 0.91 / 0.31, py_37302 foreground 1.06 / 0.31, py_37305 1.01 / 0.15. The photo petals are also irregular flakes (py_37305), not ovals.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py synth_py_confetti: darken the ground by multiplying the weave term by (1 - 0.7*dark) (was ~0.6). Make petals irregular polygons: 5-7 random vertices, radius 2.5-5 px with +-35 % per-vertex jitter. Raise petal brightness so the tile p90/p50 is ~1.7 and p10/p50 ~0.6. Keep the tile mean, so SEATMAT.pyWing '#6e7484' still sets the colour. Target: q13 foreground wing spread >= 0.85, dark share >= 0.15.
